title: I vibe coded a little game generator with a leaderboard
author: i_flowkid
selftext:
I've been working on GameSpoon, a little project where you can create games and share them with other people.

I wanted to make something where you don't just create a game and leave it sitting on your computer you can actually share it, let other people play it, and see how they score on the leaderboard.

Here's an example of a game you can play:

https://gamespoon.web.app/g/cyber-wave-assault-adcvot

And here's GameSpoon if you want to check it out:

https://gamespoon.web.app

It's still a work in progress, but I'd love to see what people think of it.

What kind of game would you try making with something like this?
